A+D.note: Bayer recalled A+D Diaper Rash Cream in February 2017 for trace diethyl phthalate, on a product labelled phthalate free. That recall is closed and nine years old, so under rule 5.2 it is informational. Two things about it are not. The recalled item was the Cream and this is the Ointment, but diethyl phthalate is a fragrance solvent and this ointment carries undisclosed Fragrance, which is a shared mechanism rather than a sibling coincidence. And it was an adverse finding on the brand's own representations: the FDA label and the Amazon listing still read PHTHALATE-FREE today, so under rule 5.1 nothing this brand says about itself can carry a pass without third party proof. The earlier FDA match on this brand was A & D Engineering, a blood pressure monitor maker with no connection to the ointment, and has been discarded.
